messages:
anya_csm: Quick note from today's NovaHealth onboarding call — two recurring pain points surfaced that we should capture and prioritize before the renewal conversation.

anya_csm: 1) token churn during bulk embedding imports — customers see intermittent 401s when the importer retries. 2) lack of per-route cost visibility in the console (finance + product teams asking for this during enablement).

mike_eng: Can you paste the failing curl/log snippet? trying to repro locally.

anya_csm: Sure — here's what the customer saw:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' 
  -d '{"input":"..."}'
# Response: 401 {"error":"token_expired"} on retry 2 of 3
```

mike_eng: thanks. looks like the SDK retry path isn't refreshing the session token for long-running import jobs. filing a short bug. will tag with repro steps.

mike_eng: created PLAT-1298 to track token refresh on long-running jobs. linked logs and repro. :white_check_mark:

onboard-bot: New ticket created: https://tracker.redwood/PLAT-1298 by @mike_eng

jess_pm: From product side — both items affect churn risk for midsize accounts. Rough prioritization ask: impact = high (renewal talk starting), effort = medium for per-route cost UI, effort = low-medium for retry fix if it's a bug. Can we get rough ETA?

mike_eng: Retry fix estimate: ~2 dev days + small test matrix. Per-route cost UI is a larger scope — need design + backend + cost attribution work, approx 3 sprints.

anya_csm: Renewal risk note: NovaHealth flagged this as a discussion point next week. if retry fix is quick we can call it out as resolved in demo. Per-route cost ask — customers want CSV export or per-route filter in billing page.

tom_onboard: For enablement, I'll prepare a one-pager workaround: recommend token rotation cadence and sample import script with exponential backoff. I'll also collect other onboarding tickets and put into shared sheet.

anya_csm: Action items: 1) @mike_eng own PLAT-1298, add repro + logs. 2) @jess_pm confirm prioritization with roadmap and link to a product ticket for cost visibility (e.g., PROD-ww). 3) @tom_onboard create workaround doc and share with NovaHealth before renewal call. 4) I'll flag NovaHealth as "renewal-watch" in Salesforce.

jess_pm: I'll create PROD-3310 for per-route cost visibility and mark it as blocker for finance UX. Will post link here when done.

anya_csm: thanks all — tagging a few other accounts with similar notes in the sheet (Brightline, ParkCo). short-term wins: PLAT-1298 + workaround. mid-term: PROD-3310.

mike_eng: noted. I'll push a patch to the SDK branch and request review today.

onboard-bot: Reminder: weekly onboarding sync in #customer-success tomorrow 10:30am.

anya_csm: FYI — copying the customer quote for context: "We can't show our CFO why costs spiked on route X — also imports fail sometimes during busy hours." :eyes:

jess_pm: Good call. I'll include this in the next roadmap review and aim to slot the cost visibility work in the next Q planning if capacity allows.

anya_csm: Closing loop here once PLAT-1298 has a fix and PROD-3310 has initial scoping. I'll update SF and ping renewals team. Thanks! :pray:
